claims.text: The frailty phenotype definition and the frailty index correlated moderately well with each other (R = 0.65).
The phenotypic definition of frailty correlated with functional measures (R = 0.66).
The frailty index correlated with functional measures (R = 0.73).
The phenotypic definition of frailty correlated with cognitive measures (R = -0.35).
The frailty index correlated with cognitive measures (R = -0.58).
Median frailty index scores increased from 0.12 for robust individuals to 0.30 for pre-frail and 0.44 for frail individuals.
Among people categorized as robust by phenotypic definition, median 5-year survival was 85% for those with lower frailty index values compared to 55% for those with higher frailty index values.

methodologies.name: Validation and comparison of frailty phenotype vs deficit accumulation index
methodologies.description: Comparison of convergent validity and criterion validity ( survival and institutionalization ) between a phenotype-based frailty measure and a deficit accumulation frailty index.
datasets: Canadian Study of Health and Aging (CSHA) Wave 2 clinical examination cohort

limitations.text: The Frailty Index requires additional clinical translation before it can be readily operationalized in clinical practice.
